subject: RECORD clause
notes: Landed by kb/Work PB1276 (w61f). cite.py --check 13.18.43.4 'specifies the size of records in the record area' -> OK §13.18.43.4 2). The explicit clause (Format 1 integer-1) and the implicit one (GR5 a, the largest description) both size the record area through FileModel.RecordWidth; positions of the area no description covers are spaces (FileConnector.FitRecord). The implementor's calculations for the size on the storage medium are docs/CONFORMANCE.md §7 row DOC-A.1-146, whose arm (a) now matches the compiler (its remaining ⚠ is the line-sequential delimiter, kb/Work PB1540, a different arm).
